what: Which pair overlaps when plate-stick fails. Each failure replayed from the start with method/plate-stick (3900896) in the referee's chunking, states projected to the failure time, minimum pair gap found (-2e-8, the engine's overlap limit). In every case one sphere of the pair is stuck on the plate (gap to plate below 1e-15 D, stuck flag 1) and the other is free and resting on it obliquely, its centre 0.3 to 0.9 D higher and 0.4 to 0.9 D to the side, with millions of pair collisions slower than 1e-10 before the overlap (counters in the replay). The replays reproduce the runs' failure cycles and phases. Script: sequel-data/tmp/ovl2.py (kept as sequel-data/runs/tools/stuck_overlap_replay.py).
